meta.name: list-segment-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build email segments from my list", "make engaged / lapsed / RFM segments", "set up cart-abandoner or lifecycle-stage audiences", or "build a suppression list of unsubscribes and bounces"; turns the user's OWN list/CRM/GA4/ecommerce export into behavioral, attribute, and lifecycle-stage segments plus a suppression list, with per-segment sizes labeled Measured/Estimated, informing the SEND E (Engagement/targeting) dimension. Not for scoring EQS or running vetoes — use email-quality-auditor; not for authentication or spam-content checks — use deliverability-qa. 邮件列表分群/生命周期分群/抑制名单/流失召回

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将邮件列表按行为和生命周期自动分群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从客户数据中构建精准邮件受众群
copy.tagline_en: Automatically segment your email list by behavior and lifecycle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build precise email audiences from customer data

howto.what: 将你上传的邮件列表、CRM或电商导出数据，自动拆分为行为分群（如活跃用户、购物车放弃者）、RFM分层、生命周期阶段（新用户、流失用户等）和抑制名单（退订、硬弹回等），并标注每个分群的大小是实测还是估算。
howto.when: 当你要求“从我的列表构建邮件分群”、“制作活跃/流失/RFM分群”、“设置购物车放弃者或生命周期阶段受众”，或“构建退订和弹回的抑制名单”时触发。

say.text: 从我的列表导出构建邮件分群，目标为留存。
say.note: 技能会分析数据并输出分群地图。

say.text: 制作活跃90天、流失和购物车放弃者分群，并给出抑制名单。
say.note: 技能会生成行为分群和抑制名单。

say.text: 将我的CRM导出映射到RFM分层和生命周期阶段。
say.note: 技能会输出可复用的分群定义。

howto.what_en: Turns your uploaded list, CRM, or ecommerce export into behavioral segments (e.g., engaged-90d, cart-abandoners), RFM tiers, lifecycle stages (new, lapsed, win-back), and a suppression list (unsubscribed, hard-bounced), with each segment size labeled Measured or Estimated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build email segments from my list", "make engaged/lapsed/RFM segments", "set up cart-abandoner or lifecycle-stage audiences", or "build a suppression list of unsubscribes and bounces".

say_en.text: Build email segments from my list export, goal is retention.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze the data and output a segment map.

say_en.text: Make engaged-90d, lapsed, and cart-abandoner segments, plus the suppression list.
say_en.note: The skill will generate behavioral segments and a suppression list.

say_en.text: Map my CRM export to RFM tiers and lifecycle stages.
say_en.note: The skill will output reusable segment definitions.
